page.notes: Arabic passages are transcribed from a small, slightly blurred print; words marked [?] are uncertain, especially the vocalised forms and the final words of the Arabic lines. The Latin lemma and the English-style abbreviations were read directly. The catchword "fentiam" was printed with a long s and is given here as "sentiam" under the house rule. The asterisk in the left margin is placed beside the Arabic line "attributa afferere". No printing errors were corrected.
